@@U00519@@
you'll do so with greater pleasure. So suck away, my boy!

@@U00521@@
Oh, sir, I'll embrace her, and gladly! But do tell me how to find my way?

@@U00523@@
Tell me first, what major have you chosen?

@@U00525@@
I want to be really learned! I want to master everything! Heaven, earth, science, nature! I want it all!

@@U00527@@
Ah, yes! You're on the right track, my boy; just never let distraction lead you astray.

@@U00529@@
Well, I mean— however set on this I may be, Vd still like a bit of recreation now and again, an outing on summer holidays, and such.

@@U00531@@
Time slips away so fast, you must never waste it. But method will teach you that, my boy. Order. System. And so I advise you first to take up Logic. It will put your mind in fine fettle, drill it into submission, lace it into iron boots, and from then on it will creep and shuffle ponderously down the path of thought, never again go will-o’-the-wisping, flitting about this way and that, crisscrossing hither and yon.
translation:
@@U00519@@
你会更加高兴地这样做。所以吸走吧，我的孩子！

@@U00521@@
哦，先生，我会很高兴地拥抱她！但请告诉我如何找到我的路？

@@U00523@@
先告诉我，你选什么专业？

@@U00525@@
我想真正有学问！我想掌握一切！天、地、科学、自然！我全都要！

@@U00527@@
啊，是的！你走在正确的道路上，我的孩子；只是永远不要让分心让你误入歧途。

@@U00529@@
嗯，我的意思是——无论我的决心如何，我仍然喜欢时不时地进行一些娱乐活动，比如暑假郊游等等。

@@U00531@@
时间过得真快，千万不能浪费。但方法会教你这一点，我的孩子。命令。系统。所以我建议你首先学习逻辑学。它会让你的心处于良好的状态，让它屈服，把它系在铁靴子里，从此它就会在思想的道路上缓慢地爬行、拖曳，再也不会像鬼火一样，东奔西跑，东奔西走。
